public_summary: PrismML's ternary Bonsai 2 27B packs a 27B-class hybrid-attention reasoning model into 5.95 GB (PTQ1_0, 1.75 bpw) and requires PrismML's llama.cpp fork. On an RTX 5070 it decodes at ~59 tok/s with a fully GPU-resident profile and validates useful context at 32K, but fails frozen reliability gates under its default xhigh thinking mode (budget exhaustion, not fabrication). A paired study against a practical Qwen3.8-27B reference finds near-parity on 48 mechanically-scored tasks with a narrow fluent-fabrication tail. The same artifact also runs on an 8 GB RTX 2060 SUPER via the same pinned fork source.
